rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a broad uncultivated landscape such as a moor.

example.english: There’s no signal once you walk into this moor.
example.traditional: 呢片荒野行入去就冇訊號喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin3 fong1 je5 haang4 jap6 heoi3 zau6 mou5 seon3 hou6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a more precise or literary description of bleak open heathland or moorland.

example.english: Under the setting sun, the moor stretches endlessly, with only the sound of the wind.
example.traditional: 夕陽下，荒原一望無際，只有風聲。
example.jyutping: zik6 joeng4 haa6 fong1 jyun4 jat1 mong6 mou4 zai3 zi2 jau5 fung1 sing1
